author: CBR
description:
Why would Marvel skip the Super Bowl trailer spotlight? In this clip, Sean O'Connell and Sierra Nutkevitch react to Avengers: Doomsday and Spider-Man: Brand New Day not showing footage during the Super Bowl, even though the game is historically where the biggest blockbusters debut trailers. 

We break down what that choice could mean for Marvel Studios, the MCU, and reaching casual audiences.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 17.
